title: P104: two additional chart contractions over #7601 (conditional κ 0.003650000454083)
body:
## Contribution
Two additional exact chart contractions on pending #7601: public role 166 (charts 327 → 783 → 907), and role 134 (618 → 789 → 913, cancelling adjacent opposite ADDs). Paid calls 110,434 → 110,400 in the retained 17-stage application; 22,461 independent productive fields preserved. Conditional candidate κ = 0.003650000454083; raw crossing bracket [0.0036500004540838632736187363, 0.0036500004540838632736187364]. This is not an unconditional theorem, selected-frontier update or practical speedup.

## Validation
Run `python -I -B -S -W error research/p104-two-chart-contractions/verify.py` (Python 3.12+, standard library). Fresh Windows replay and final wrapper both passed 8 receipts and 353 input hashes. Candidate replay 50.23s/59.31s. These are independent executions of supplied checks, not independently authored proof verification. Checks cover 1,501 arbitrary public-input rows, owned retirement data, changed chart-pair identities, signed caller, 13,600 phase contacts, precision/tape accounting and inherited outer inequalities. README/PROOF/VALIDATION and immutable source archive included.

## Scope and remaining work
Five assumptions remain: native_all_columns, owned_erasure, compiler, precision_tape, analytic_recovery. No full materialized multiplier, complete upstream hosted suite, independent human review or formal-kernel multiplication theorem verification. Local accounting is not an independent complete theorem/cost audit. Archive-based standalone replay is not yet registered in upstream research-package CI; review is requested, while integration and verification limitations remain. No selected-result/shared code changes. 209 stock-census cases remain unresolved; no universal impossibility claim.

Prepared for @SYLforge with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0. Latest PR refresh included #7602, no identical addition found, no exhaustive novelty claim.
